findings.evidence: Gameplay hand 1, mobile 390×844 — action buttons not fully visible without scrolling
findings.finding: Decision buttons require scrolling to reach on mobile — users may not realize they need to scroll
findings.why: Core gameplay mechanic is hidden; users may time out without deciding
findings.fix: Reduce vertical spacing in the session layout; ensure buttons fit in viewport

findings.evidence: Dashboard, desktop — account menu button height 30.0px
findings.finding: Account menu button below 44px tap target
findings.why: Sign-out path becomes hard to tap on mobile

findings.evidence: [static review] SignIn.jsx lines 84-86 — once showSignIn=true, the si-guest-btn disappears; no "Back" or "Never mind" link rendered
findings.finding: No way back to the guest CTA once the user taps "Already have an account? Sign in"
findings.why: A curious user who taps the sign-in reveal cannot return to the "Play a Free Session" primary path — they are stuck in the sign-in form
findings.fix: Add a "← Back" or "Continue as guest" link when showSignIn=true and onGuestPlay is set

findings.evidence: [static review] SignIn.jsx line 109 — submit button disabled without explanation when email field is empty
findings.finding: Email submit button is disabled with no affordance explaining why — new users may not understand it requires a valid email
findings.why: Disabled state without explanation leaves users confused about what to do
findings.fix: Add placeholder/hint text or enable the button and validate on submit instead

clean: Chained session starts successfully (found by text)
